title.en: Theory of Becoming — current first priority
title.zh: 生成／变化之论——当前首要研究方向

scope.en: Ren's current first priority for the continuing foundation programme: explain the whole scope of becoming, including generation and degeneration. Preserve completed ethical and evolutionary results and the scopes of independently authorized tasks. Ren clarifies that deductive necessity concerns the whole Theory of Becoming; generativity is within its manifold.
scope.zh: Ren 为持续基础研究确立的当前首要方向：解释包含生成与退化的整个变化范围。保留已完成伦理、演化成果及其他独立授权任务的范围。 Ren进一步明确：演绎必然性的对象是Theory of Becoming整体；生成性是其manifold的部分。

objective.en: Establish the deductive necessity of the Theory of Becoming as a whole without added substantive axioms; explain generative forms within its manifold. Articulate how relations form, persist, transform and dissolve, including life and evolution, without requiring every becoming to be generative or favorably directed.
objective.zh: 无需附加实质公理，建立Theory of Becoming整体的演绎必然性，并说明其manifold中的生成形态。阐明关系怎样形成、维持、转化与消失，包含生命与演化，不要求每种变化均有生成性或有利方向。

premises.en: Begin with the monist relational method and disclose its role. Retain mixed effects, real losses and terminal continuations. Distinguish logical machinery, definitions, local laws, correspondence and normative commitments; a supplied local law is not thereby external to reality. G0 is folded (Ren, 11 October 2026): it is not an axiom. Part I states it as a condition, characterized with no axiom and left undecided by the dynamics, together with everything else that holds for any significance (chapter section 6, moved into Part I on Ren's decision of the same day); the former Part II asserted only the one axiom, and on 16 October 2026 Ren folded it into the conditional section 6.15 of the chapter: the theory does not assert it, and with it as a condition G0 is a theorem. Positive relevance is folded into significance, and courses are compared on possibilities (the AI's decision on Ren's delegation). The generative space is stated with no axiom: a part is generative where the levels with it widen those without it, and on level paths C is a law with “better” read as widening; the one axiom enters only as a condition, under which widening is retaining and adding what has significance (section 6.15). J and the other practical commitments remain explicit within the whole, without becoming premises of every dynamical explanation.
premises.zh: 从一元关系方法开始并公开其作用，保留混合后果、真实损失与接续终止。区分逻辑工具、定义、局部规律、实际对应及规范承诺；局部给定规律不因此外在于现实。G0 已折叠（Ren 2026-10-11）：它不是公理。第一部分把它作为条件陈述，不用公理刻画其内容，动力学不决定它；对任何意义成立的其余规律也在第一部分（章节 §6，Ren 同日决定移入）；原第二部分只断言那一条公理，Ren 2026-10-16 把它折叠为章节 §6.15 的条件小节：理论不断言它，以它为条件 G0 是定理。正面相关折叠进意义，继续之间以可能性比较（AI 依 Ren 的交托决定）。生成的空间不用公理陈述：部分在有它的水平扩大无它的水平之处是生成的；在水平路径上把“更好”读作扩大，C 是规律；那一条公理只作为条件出现，扩大在它之下就是保留且增加有意义者（§6.15）。J 与其他实践承诺仍是整体内公开的承诺，不成为每项动态解释的前提。

completion.en: Reuse completed conditional mechanisms and identify the exact remaining foundational inference. Assess zero normative axioms and zero added substantive axioms separately; neither outcome inclusion, an empty Lean axiom report nor hidden hypotheses establishes the stronger target. Explain actual possibilities and constraints, expose remaining dependencies, and preserve substantive counterexamples. This priority authorization does not certify a new result or universal completion. Establish the whole claim at its stated scope; do not substitute universal generativity for the whole or treat a mode’s absence as its refutation.
completion.zh: 复用已完成条件机制，指出尚缺的确切基础推论。分别检验无规范公理与无附加实质公理；包容全部结果、空 Lean 公理报告或隐藏假设都不等于更强目标成立。说明实际可能与限制，公开剩余依赖并保留实质反例。本优先授权不认证新成果或普遍完成。 按所声明范围建立整体主张；不以普遍生成性替换整体，不把某种形态缺失直接视为整体反例。

title.zh: 首要研究方向：生成／变化之论

summary.en: Ren locates deductive necessity in the Theory of Becoming as a whole; generativity is within its manifold. Develop that deduction without added substantive axioms, retaining persistence, degeneration, dissolution and mixed changes. Life, evolution and G0/J evaluation remain differentiated within the same reality.
summary.zh: Ren明确整体Theory of Becoming是演绎必然性的对象，生成性是其manifold中的部分。无需附加实质公理推进这一演绎，保留维持、退化、消解及混合变化；生命、演化与G0/J评价在同一现实中分化。

next_step.en: Ren's zero-premise redirect of 11 October: remove premises and derive the most general version of each Part I law, zero premises first. Inventory where each main theorem uses a premise, finiteness, enclosure or decidability; restate each localizable law for every world as “Y iff Z”, Z holding of that world at the steps and relata the proof uses, with the selection theorems as corollaries; put commitments of the representation to Ren; test each law against weakening the representation. The selection tables are not extended further, and no premise is claimed derived where the representation proves it contingent.
next_step.zh: Ren 2026-10-11 的零前提转向：去掉前提，先以零前提推出第一部分每条规律最一般的形式。清点每条主要定理在哪里用到前提、有限、被围住或可判定；把可局部化的规律对每个世界重述为“Y 当且仅当 Z”，Z 是该世界在证明所用的步与关系项上的条件，选择定理作为推论；表示的承诺交 Ren 决定；检验每条规律在削弱表示后是否成立。不再扩展选择表；表示证明其偶然的前提，不声称已推出。
